Values._comment_credential: LOCAL DEV ONLY. The Functions HOST authenticates to AzureWebJobsStorage in its own process and CANNOT use the interactive browser — only non-interactive developer credentials (Visual Studio sign-in, Azure PowerShell, az login). AZURE_TOKEN_CREDENTIALS=dev limits DefaultAzureCredential to those and skips the Managed Identity / IMDS probe that fails 'Identity not found' on a box with no assigned identity. Not set in Azure, where the Function App's Managed Identity is used.
Values._comment_storage: Identity-based storage (no connection string / account key). AzureWebJobsStorage__* is the HOST plumbing connection (BlobTrigger control queue, QueueTrigger listener, host leases) resolved natively by the Functions runtime. StorageAccountUrl is the APP-level connection (BlobServiceClient/QueueServiceClient: landing→processed/failed lifecycle, error archive, dead-letter queue) — kept separate so app data storage is independent of host plumbing; the queue endpoint is derived from it (.blob.→.queue.). Point both at the same account. All authenticate via DefaultAzureCredential: Managed Identity in Azure, your VS/CLI dev sign-in locally. Identity needs Storage Blob Data Contributor + Storage Queue Data Contributor. Copy this file to local.settings.json and fill in real values — local.settings.json is gitignored.
